messages:
maria_g: Quick pulse — we need a tight social plan for the benchmark webinar. Goal: 400 signups, route hot leads to SDRs within 30m. Who owns assets, copy, and routing?

olivia_marketing: Ill draft 2 X headlines, a 3-tweet thread opener, and the LinkedIn long form. Can also make 10s teaser reels if we get speaker clips.

jake_p: Ill produce hero 1200x675, square 1080x1080, and a 15s silent clip. Need final stat and logo files. Aim for EOD.

sam_ops: Routing draft: Drift -> HubSpot enrich. If form_id == "f9c2-web-2026" AND lead.score >= 40 assign to `sdr_priority` + post to #sales-inbound. Else add to `webinar_nurture`. Ill build the workflow and add pixel rdw_pixel_2026_web.

tom_sales: Confirm SLA 30m for priority. Ill publish SDR rota and a 5-item reply library (pricing, dedicated, security, demo, case study) by tomorrow AM.

maria_g: Cadence to A/B hooks:
Mon 10am X (stat + CTA)
Tue 12pm LinkedIn (long post + quote)
Wed 11am X thread (3 posts)
Thu 3pm X reminder (clip)
Fri 9am LinkedIn final nudge
All links must include utm_campaign=webinar_may2026.

olivia_marketing: Copy variants (short): A) "We cut inference cost 3.8x — see how. Webinar signup: <link>" B) "Latency vs cost: our benchmark reveals the sweet spot. RSVP: <link>"
Which is primary?

maria_g: Use A as primary (bench-led) and B as variant. Jake tag assets `bench_primary` / `bench_variant`. Sam, attach HubSpot workflow link when ready.

sam_ops: Will post the workflow YAML and pixel confirmation in this thread when live.

jake_p: On it, delivering drafts EOD.

maria_g: Action items captured. Review at 4pm in #marketing-ops. :thumbsup:
